title: Mattel Hot Wheels Roborace Robocar HW Race Day 9/10 Black Yellow 161/250
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Diecast & Toy Vehicles:Cars, Trucks & Vans:Contemporary Manufacture
descriptionText: The product is a Hot Wheels Roborace Robocar from the HW Race Day series, featuring a sleek black color scheme with yellow accents. This 1:64 scale diecast car is part of the Roborace collection, perfect for car enthusiasts and collectors alike. With its unique design and high-quality construction, this Hot Wheels car is sure to be a standout in any collection.
